measurement_note: Size N is the book count, with exactly six reading sessions per book and R = 6N. Tiers 8, 32, and 128 span 16x. The accepted query groups the session relation once and sorts the qualifying books; a correct correlated-subquery formulation repeatedly scans all session rows for every book and is quadratic, so it must complete every tier and fail only scaling.
